description: This file defines a PHP class SetTokenParser within the Twig templating engine. The class is responsible for parsing 'set' tag statements in Twig templates to assign values to variables or blocks.

classes.name: SetTokenParser
classes.description: Final class responsible for parsing 'set' tags in Twig templates, extending AbstractTokenParser and implementing specific parsing logic for variable assignment and block capturing.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a 'set' token, handling different assignment scenarios, and returns a SetNode representing the parsed set statement.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token marks the end of a 'set' block by testing for 'endset'.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the string 'set', indicating the token this parser handles.
